content.text:
The tests now pass: all three pass when I run `python3 tests/test_core.py`. There were two bugs in `textstats/core.py`:

- **Apostrophes:** The tokenizer regex `[a-z]+` split "don't" into "don" and "t", so `word_count("don't stop")` returned 3. It is now `[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)*`, which keeps apostrophes inside words.
- **Tie order:** `top_words` sorted only by descending count, so tied words came out in insertion order. The sort key is now `(-count, word)`, which breaks ties alphabetically.

I didn't edit the tests.
